_doc: Source registry. tier 0 = built-in web search/fetch used sparingly; tier 1 = free scripted API; tier 2 = needs a key/approval requested through a human task; excluded = never fetch. 'kinds' lists what a landscape unit on this family can surface (used for per-kind saturation). Re-checked by `gapscan.py doctor` at the start of every run; update verified_on when you re-verify.

web.name: Built-in web search (agent tool)
web.access: Agent WebSearch tool; log every query with `gapscan.py log-query`. Snapshot any page you quote with `gapscan.py snapshot`.
web.tos: Respect each result site's robots.txt and terms; never fetch excluded domains.

directories.name: Public directory listings (listing pages only)
directories.access: Listing pages of Slack App Directory, Shopify App Store, Zapier app directory, Chrome Web Store, Google Play, AlternativeTo: use them to discover names and links only. Record each product's own homepage as `url` and the listing as `listing_url`; if no homepage is visible, leave the product out. AlternativeTo answers automated fetches with HTTP 403 (observed in a live run), so an entity known only by its AlternativeTo page cannot be screened.
directories.tos: Robots-limited; Shopify ToS is anti-bot; AlternativeTo forbids building a competing database: record pointers, do not copy listings.

vendor.name: Vendor public pages (pricing, changelog, docs, public roadmap, status, feature-request boards)
vendor.tos: Public pages only; never log in.

hn.name: Hacker News via Algolia API
hn.limits: about 10k requests/hour per IP (secondary source); scripts space requests by 1s

se.name: Stack Exchange API 2.3
se.auth: none (300 requests/day per IP) or free key via STACKEXCHANGE_KEY (10k/day)
se.tos: Content is CC BY-SA 4.0: keep attribution (URL) with every quote.

gh.name: GitHub search via the gh CLI
gh.endpoint: gh search issues|repos ; gh api graphql (discussions)
gh.auth: gh auth login (the human's GitHub account)
gh.limits: search API 30 requests/min authenticated, 1000 results per query
gh.tos: GitHub API terms; public repositories only.

wiki.name: Wikimedia Pageviews API
wiki.auth: none, but a User-Agent with contact information is required (set MGD_CONTACT)
wiki.limits: 10 requests/min unidentified, 200/min with a contact User-Agent

wp.name: WordPress.org plugin directory API + review feeds
wp.limits: not published; scripts space requests by 2s

apple.name: Apple iTunes Search API + App Store customer-review JSON feed
apple.limits: review feed is undocumented: pages 1-10 x 50 reviews per storefront; space requests by 3s
apple.tos: Undocumented feed; use sparingly and keep quotes short.

yc.name: Y Combinator company directory (yc-oss mirror)
yc.limits: static JSON; cache it per run
yc.tos: Unofficial daily mirror of YC's public index; ycombinator.com/companies?* is disallowed by robots.txt, so never scrape it directly.

saashub.name: SaaSHub API (free beta key, attribution required)
saashub.tos: Credit SaaSHub wherever its data appears.

producthunt.name: Product Hunt API v2
producthunt.tos: Must not be used for commercial purposes without permission: request permission before enabling.

reddit.name: Reddit Data API (OAuth)
reddit.tos: Requires prior approval under the Responsible Builder Policy; new requests close 2026-10-31; commercial use needs a contract; no ML training on content. Enable only if the human already holds approved access. Unauthenticated .json/RSS is excluded.

trends.name: Google Trends API (alpha, by application)
trends.tos: Alpha access only; never scrape trends.google.com (pytrends is archived).

keyword_planner.name: Google Ads Keyword Planner via Google Ads API
keyword_planner.tos: Needs a Google Ads account and developer token.

serpapi.name: SerpApi (250 free searches/month)
serpapi.tos: Vendor carries the scraping risk; mind the monthly quota.

dataforseo.name: DataForSEO (pay as you go, $50 minimum)
dataforseo.tos: Paid API; spending requires a human task.

x.name: X API (pay per use)
x.tos: About $0.005 per post read; spending requires a human task.

excluded.reason: Terms ban scrapers and headless browsers and using content to train, test or analyse ML; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot on review paths.
Terms ban automated extraction (Gartner Digital Markets; acquisition by G2 announced 2026-01-29).
Review-site terms prohibit automated extraction (not fully verified); excluded conservatively.
Login-walled; hiQ v. LinkedIn ended with an injunction.
Unauthenticated .json returns 403 and RSS ends 2026-11-13; only the tier-2 OAuth API with prior approval is allowed.
Reddit short links; same as reddit.com.

excluded_paths.reason: Disallowed by robots.txt; Google terms ban automated access that ignores robots.txt.
Disallowed by robots.txt; use the yc-oss mirror.
